title: Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, probes continue
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: Nvidia jumped 31.5% on Mon 23 Nov after Huang was reinstated, then retreated 7% on Tue 24 Nov, giving back some of the surge, Yahoo Finance and FinanceFeeds report; CNBC reports the board voted after assurances from Trump that Huang had not broken US national security laws. The board says its committee's investigation will proceed to conclusion, and Huang still faces closed-door House interviews on 1 Dec and a Senate Banking hearing on 3 Dec, Investing.com reports.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
next_label: House committees' closed-door interview with Huang, Senate hearing 3 Dec
sources: Nvidia, CNBC, Yahoo Finance, FinanceFeeds, MS NOW, CNN, Investing.com

title: US readies sweeping new tariffs on China and EU
since_label: Tue 24 Nov 13:00 UTC, before the WSJ tariff report
status: Citing the Wall Street Journal, Investing.com reports the administration is preparing broad new tariffs on China, the EU and dozens of other partners, and USTR Greer could unveil the findings of his subsidy probe as soon as this week; China would face the steepest rates and no rates or official announcement have been published. Bloomberg reports US stocks fell, led by chipmakers, as the tariff plans renewed trade concerns, with the Nasdaq 100 down about 3% by late morning; the final rates and timing are still open.
why: Tariffs on China and the EU hit chip and AI hardware supply chains and feed inflation and Fed hike odds, which weigh on the Nasdaq and crypto together.
next_label: USTR probe findings, possibly this week per WSJ
sources: WSJ, Bloomberg, Investing.com, Yahoo Finance, KuCoin

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: Bitcoin Magazine reports bitcoin slipped back to near $60,000 early Tuesday as the Nvidia rally cooled and spot ETFs posted another heavy day of outflows, and Strategy's 23 Nov 8-K shows it bought just 457 BTC for $29.6 million from 16 to 22 Nov. MSCI's deletion takes effect at the 30 Nov close and the revised index goes live 1 Dec; Yahoo Finance cites a JPMorgan estimate of up to $9B in outflows if other index providers follow, which is still open.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, Bitcoin Magazine, TradingNews, Investing News, Yahoo Finance, CoinGecko

title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Bloomberg reports ANT fell as low as $76.03 on Tue 24 Nov in a broad equity pullback, after first breaking its $83 IPO price in premarket trading, down from Monday's $87.64 close. StockAnalysis reports filings show the CEO and President each sold 3.4M shares on 20 Nov; whether ANT regains its IPO price and when it joins the Nasdaq 100 are still open.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
sources: Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Fast Company, StockAnalysis, Morningstar, CNBC, Robinhood

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: Iranian state TV reported on Tue 24 Nov that chief negotiator Qalibaf said Tehran will not negotiate with Washington until Iran's seven conditions are met, which state media say include lifting the US naval blockade, and Iran said three tankers struck naval mines in Hormuz and caught fire, the Washington Post and Investing.com report. Iran's reported 14-tanker convoy at Kharg has not been confirmed sailing, Trump has said Washington could resume attacks after the new year, and no ceasefire has been announced.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: AP, Washington Post, Investing.com, The Business Standard, UKMTO, Fox News, Gulf News, CoinDesk
